results.title: 2026 Generic Ballot Polling Average - Midterm Polls — Race to the WH
results.snippet: Generic Ballot polls ask voters across the country whether they would rather vote for a generic Democrat or Republican in the next election . This is a useful indicator that showcases which party is in the lead and whether the 2026 midterms will ...

results.title: Generic Congressional Ballot: Latest Polls | Silver Bulletin
results.snippet: The generic ballot hasn’t seen much movement over the past month. Today, Democrats’ margin is sitting at D +6.6. At the beginning of August, it was a nearly identical D +6.5. In other Silver Bulletin news, we launched our 2026 midterm election forecast this month.

results.title: 2026 Midterm Elections Generic Ballot Tracker
results.snippet: Morning Consult is tracking whom Americans across the country are planning to vote for in the 2026 midterm elections. Each week, we’ll update this page with our latest generic ballot surveys of tens of thousands of registered voters, including granular demographic subgroups.

results.title: Who Is Favored to Win the House? Latest 2026 Congressional Ballot Polls - The New York Times
results.snippet: ... Recent polling on the congressional generic ballot shows Democrats with a modest advantage . The party out of power typically gains ground in midterm elections, and these early surveys suggest this may be taking shape ahead of 2026.

results.title: 2026 Generic Ballot | Latest Polls & Polling Average
results.snippet: Time-weighted polling average measuring Americans' generic party preference for the 2026 midterm elections.

results.title: Which party will win the House in 2026? Trading Odds & Predictions (Nov. 3, 2026) | Polymarket
results.snippet: If no party wins a majority of voting seats, the chamber will be deemed controlled by the party with which the first elected Speaker of the House of the Congress that convenes after the 2026 midterm election is affiliated .

results.title: 2026 Midterms Prediction Markets — Live Kalshi & Polymarket Prices
results.snippet: 34 of the 35 Senate seats up in 2026 have tradeable Kalshi markets, including the Ohio (Vance seat) and Florida (Rubio seat) Class 3 specials. Only Louisiana has no tradeable market yet — just an empty shell that we re-probe on a schedule. No. Of the 435 House seats, 66 competitive districts have individual Kalshi markets ...

results.title: Who will control Congress after 2026 midterms? New polls, predictions
results.snippet: In Polymarket betting odds on who ... a 50% Democratic Party sweep to win in both the Senate and the House. 89% favor a Democratic Party win for the House in midterms 2026 · 51% favor a Democratic Party win for the Senate in midterms 2026 · 50% favor a Democratic sweep of the House and Senate in midterms 2026 · 12% favor a Republican sweep of the House and Senate in midterms 2026 · The Kalshi market predictions on midterm election favor a Democratic sweep with 47% over a split congress with 38%

results.title: Kalshi Prediction Markets for Select House 2026 Elections - 270toWin
results.snippet: The tables below display the live prediction market odds from Kalshi for select 2026 House elections. Also displayed are markets that reflect the probabilities for control of Congress after the 2026 midterms.

results.title: 2026 Midterm Election Odds Tracker: Live Prediction Market Comparison
results.snippet: Several prediction market apps, including Kalshi and Polymarket, offer political prediction markets that are similar but not identical. They offer odds on Senate Control, House Control, who will win the Governor and Senate races across the country, and on individual House races.
